_comment: Sentinel probe (TM-01, TB3): defaultPolicy block is implemented as NO network device attached (threat model section 12 — kernel-level absence beats filtering). The probe asserts no interface other than lo exists and that direct-to-IP egress (no DNS, so guest resolv.conf games are irrelevant) fails.

process.commandLine: devs=$(ls /sys/class/net 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^lo$'); if [ -n "$devs" ]; then echo "NETDEV_PRESENT_LEAK $devs"; else echo NETDEV_ABSENT_OK; fi; if wget -q -O /dev/null -T 3 http://1.1.1.1/ 2>/dev/null; then echo EGRESS_LEAK; else echo EGRESS_BLOCKED_OK; fi
